_readme: Venues that publish their programme on Instagram instead of a website.
paste: the post's caption, copied verbatim. Both shapes are read:
monthly: '1.9 | שלישי | 20:00 | היומן' (title on the date line)
weekly:  'השבוע על המסך: אני רובוט | I Robot' then 'שלישי | 20.10 | 20:00'
screenings: explicit {date, time, title} entries, for anything else.
'year' is the year the pasted dates belong to (they carry no year of their own).
